spanish: Si como muerte de todo el adam murieren estos, y visita de todo el adam fuere visitada sobre ellos, no Jehová me envió.

findings.issue: הָאָדָם is a definite common noun (H120), not a proper name; adam leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
יִפָּקֵד is niphal imperfect 3ms, while visitada is feminine to agree with visita (פְּקֻדָּה, feminine). Agreement smoothing does not change the passive sense.

notes: Conditional, death-of-all, these die, visitation upon them, and Jehová did not send me match the remaining tokens.
